prompt: Using the first image for the robot's own point of view (its armoured grey hull and two rubber tracks at the bottom of frame, seen from just behind its sensor) and for the bunker entrance with its green blast doors, the second image for the long grassy chalk down, the overcast light and how far off the bunker is, and the third image for the tracked robot's design: the same view from behind the robot's hull, but it has just braked to a dead stop halfway up the long slope, far short of the bunker. Two fresh furrows of torn turf and chalk end abruptly under the front of the tracks, and the cloud of chalk dust the robot was throwing up keeps rolling forward past it, drifting on ahead up the slope. Clods of earth still falling, the tracks now still. Overcast grey sky.
